objective: Implement a governed provider-neutral historical backfill baseline that archives exact provider payload pages through the canonical P06-A immutable raw archive, with deterministic request identity, bounded offline execution, resumable idempotency and fail-closed rights handling.
scope: Define provider-neutral historical backfill request, page and result contracts
Implement deterministic backfill request fingerprinting over request metadata and exact payload digests
Archive historical page payloads through the canonical P06-A FilesystemRawArchive reference contract
Preserve exact provider payload bytes without normalization or transformation
Validate half-open historical windows and page ordinals before any archive mutation
Require non-empty contiguous page sequences within configured page and byte bounds
Propagate provider/source/capture/source-event/source-time/rights/retention metadata into raw archive evidence
Make rerunning the same backfill input idempotent through the content-addressed raw archive
Fail closed for forbidden, unverified or incomplete limited-retention rights
Add deterministic offline P06-B evidence and CI regression tests
Reconcile P06-B active task/lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Claiming or using real provider historical entitlements, credentials or network connectivity
Selecting a production historical-data provider or storage vendor
Trading, order execution, KYC, funding or production activation
dependencies: P02 D04 Raw / Historical Data architecture frozen
Fresh Live Guard: no active task, active lock or open PR at execution start
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P06 product source
Historical request window uses valid half-open start/end semantics
Page ordinals are contiguous, unique and validated before archive mutation
Backfill page count and total-byte bounds fail closed before archive mutation
Exact historical page bytes and SHA-256 digests are preserved through P06-A
Backfill request fingerprint is deterministic and content-sensitive
Rerunning identical backfill input is idempotent
No provider-specific adapter import exists in historical-data core
P06-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No credential or network access is required
Historical entitlement/retention uncertainty is never treated as authorization
Production historical provider entitlement remains NOT_ASSUMED
rollback: Revert the P06-B reference backfill module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and P06-B active-state reconciliation. P06-A remains canonical; no provider entitlement, credential, network connection, production storage selection or trading state is changed.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock at Fresh Live Guard
No open pull request conflicting with shared state
